source: segmentation (Blender render, background replaced by white)
units: pixels (x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale has been assumed

camera.evidence: ramp silhouette bbox identical in every frame (x 424-~998 at top row, y 487-1079), silhouette centroid varies < 3 px only because the block changes the silhouette; background is pure white (segmented), so no other background features exist
camera.perspective: oblique 3/4 view of the ramp (its top face and front side are both visible), but the scene is labelled 2D: the block moves along a straight image line (perpendicular scatter std 0.4 px over frames 0-39), so a single px scale along the ramp is the natural choice. Foreshortening of the ramp along its length is not measurable (no grid/background).

objects.name: block
objects.description: small cream/beige rounded rectangular block (looks like an eraser) lying lengthwise in the ramp's trough; the only moving object
objects.visible_frames: 0-39 fully (37-39 lower edge slightly hidden by the trough rim), 40-41 almost entirely hidden (only a thin sliver), 42 partly visible below the ramp end lip, 43 fully visible in the air below the ramp end, 44 not visible
objects.reference_point: cx, cy = centroid of the full block silhouette at frame 24 carried by template matching (frames 0-39); mask centroid for 42-43; empty for 40, 41, 44

pixel_size.note_width: silhouette width across the axis on the ramp = top face + visible side face (about 29-32 px); in the air at frame 43 the rotated block measures 83.3 x 34.9 px
pixel_size.source: median over frames 0-36 of len_main_axis / width_across in tracks/block.csv

path_on_ramp.straightness: perpendicular residual std 0.4 px, max 1.5 px (frames 0-39)

objects.name: ramp
objects.description: long reddish-brown wooden ramp with a grey trough/channel on top, raised rims, rounded moulded sides and two feet; inclined down to the left; lower-left end has a protruding lip; the lower-left foot touches the bottom image edge (ramp may be cut off there)

pixel_extents.top_rim_note: extreme points of the upper 15% band of the silhouette along the ramp axis (scripts/check.py); approximate ramp top length, +-10 px
pixel_extents.note: silhouette includes rims, moulding and feet; measured at frame 44 (block gone); the bottom of the silhouette touches the image edge

events.detail: first clear displacement (s = 2.5 px at frame 3, 4.8 px at frame 4); motion probably begins between frames 2 and 3

events.event: block sliding down the trough, speeding up
events.detail: straight line at 26.0 deg below horizontal (image), per-frame step grows from ~2 px to ~38 px

events.event: block reaches lower end of ramp, mostly hidden at the lip
block leaves the ramp end (dropping off)
events.detail: seen partly below the lip at (452.5, 965.4)

events.event: block airborne below the ramp end, tilted

frame_timing_irregularity.detail: the video contains exact repeats (frame identical to the previous one) and, 1-3 frames before each repeat, a step about twice the neighbouring steps: the clip appears to be resampled from a render with jittered timing. One-frame backward differences are 0 at the duplicates and ~2x at the double steps. See notes.md for an estimated true render index per frame.
